tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Primary surface, about 60% of any layout: page background, cards, logo tiles. Social, email and print always use the light value.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Rare quiet fill (form fields, subtle wells). Never a section background: the club rejected tan and cream bands.

tokens.name: maroon-50
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost buttons and photo placeholders only.

tokens.name: maroon-100
tokens.usage: Body text and labels on maroon-600 and maroon-700 panels (7:1 and 9:1).

tokens.name: maroon-600
tokens.usage: The club colour. Rounded panels (stats, community), primary nav button, eyebrows, headline accent words and links on white (9.4:1). In the website's dark theme it fails as text on the dark ground (1.95:1): use it there for fills only.

tokens.name: maroon-700
tokens.usage: Deeper maroon for the social-club panel and hover states on maroon buttons.

tokens.name: maroon-900
tokens.usage: Darkest maroon: text on maroon-50, deep accents in print.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Accent dark, about 10%: header rule, footer, schedule card, What-is-footy cards, text on yellow (10.9:1). Never navy.

tokens.name: yellow-500
tokens.usage: Accent only, about 5%: primary buttons (with charcoal text), short rules, badges, eyebrows on maroon or charcoal. Never text on white (1.7:1).

tokens.name: yellow-600
tokens.usage: Hover state of yellow buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on white (16.6:1).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Paragraph text and captions on white (8.3:1) and cream (7.8:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, form field borders and sponsor logo tile borders.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: The white photo frame around every club photo, in every theme.

tokens.name: navy-crest
tokens.usage: Lives only inside the club crest and clean lion lockup artwork. Never use it for type, fills, buttons or backgrounds.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Homepage hero only. Always uppercase. Scales down to 38px on phones.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Top of each inner page. Accent word in maroon-600.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Like soccer if you could use your hands. Like rugby if there were no offsides.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a page or hero headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We'll teach you the rules and the skills from scratch.
styles.usage: All running text. ink-soft on white.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above every section heading. maroon-600 on white, yellow-500 on maroon or charcoal.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons and text links that act like buttons. Uppercase.

styles.name: card-label
styles.usage: Small uppercase labels inside cards (Days, Time, Where).

styles.name: marker
styles.usage: Handwritten accent. At most two uses per page, post or flyer. Never a headline or body copy.

tokens.name: sp-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; tight icon gaps.

tokens.name: sp-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; minimum side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: sp-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; gap between cards.

tokens.name: sp-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; space above a section's call to action.

tokens.name: sp-6
tokens.usage: Stat band padding; space under a section heading block.

tokens.name: sp-7
tokens.usage: Footer padding; module padding on desktop.

tokens.name: sp-8
tokens.usage: Largest section padding (desktop sections use 56 to 88px).

tokens.name: r-btn
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tags, form fields. Squared on purpose.

tokens.name: r-photo
tokens.usage: The photo inside a white frame.

tokens.name: r-card
tokens.usage: Cards: footy cards, sponsor cards, board cards, logo tiles.

tokens.name: r-frame
tokens.usage: The white photo frame itself.

tokens.name: r-module
tokens.usage: Large rounded panels inset from the page edge (stats, social, community, closing panels). 16px on phones.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: Only on the white photo frame. Nothing else casts a shadow.
